name: Soybean Crush Spread Seasonal Pattern
description: CBOT board crush spread (ZM×0.01×44 + ZL×0.01×11 − ZS×0.01) seasonal analysis. Shows monthly boxplot distribution of the crush spread to identify whether the current level is elevated for the time of year, plus a time series with rolling seasonal z-score. All legs use NoAdjustment per cross-commodity spread rules.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — Seasonal Pattern Analysis
# CBOT Board Crush: (ZM × 0.01 × 44) + (ZL × 0.01 × 11) − (ZS × 0.01)
# All legs NoAdjustment (cross-commodity spread — D16 rule)

# --- Data: Soybeans (primary), Meal & Oil (reference) ---
zs_raw = market_data_source()()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# ffill reference data for calendar alignment
zm_close = ffill(zm.c)
zl_close = ffill(zl.c)
zs_close = zs.c

# --- Crush Spread Calculation (cents/bushel) ---
# 1 bushel soybeans yields 44 lbs meal + 11 lbs oil
# ZM quoted in $/ton, ZL in cents/lb, ZS in cents/bushel
# Convert: meal $/ton × (44 lbs / 2000 lbs/ton) = meal value per bushel
#          oil cents/lb × 11 lbs = oil value per bushel (in cents)
#          soybeans already in cents/bushel
crush_spread = (zm_close * 44.0 / 2000.0) + (zl_close * 11.0 / 100.0) - (zs_close / 100.0)

# --- Monthly grouping for seasonal analysis ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# Downsample crush spread to monthly (last value each month)
monthly_crush = downsample(target_timeframe=1M)(crush_spread)
monthly_ts = downsample(target_timeframe=1M)(ts)
monthly_month = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(monthly_ts)

# --- Seasonal Z-Score ---
# Rolling 252-day mean and std of crush spread for context
crush_mean = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(crush_spread)
crush_std = stddev(period=252)(crush_spread)
seasonal_zscore = where(is_valid(crush_std) and crush_std > 0, (crush_spread - crush_mean) / crush_std)

# --- Event Markers: Seasonal extremes (z-score > 2 or < -2) ---
is_elevated = is_valid(seasonal_zscore) and seasonal_zscore > 2.0
is_depressed = is_valid(seasonal_zscore) and seasonal_zscore < -2.0
is_extreme = is_elevated or is_depressed
extreme_label = conditional_select(is_elevated, "Elevated", is_depressed, "Depressed", "Normal")

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crush Spread Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(crush_spread, seasonal_zscore, extreme_label, is_extreme)

# --- Chart 1: Crush Spread Time Series with Z-Score ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Spread — Is It Elevated?',
    category='Crush Spread Seasonality',
    y_axis_label='Crush Spread ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d Average', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_spread, crush_mean))

# --- Chart 2: Boxplot — Monthly Distribution of Crush Spread ---
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='What Does the Crush Spread Typically Look Like Each Month?',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Crush Spread ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    median_color=Color.White,
    whisker_iqr=1.5,
    show_outliers=True,
    category='Crush Spread Seasonality',
    order=1
)(label=monthly_month, values=monthly_crush)

# --- Chart 3: Seasonal Z-Score Time Series ---
xy_lines(
    title='How Extreme Is the Current Crush vs Seasonal Norm?',
    category='Crush Spread Seasonality',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (vs 252d)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Seasonal Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Fair Value'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Elevated (+2σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Depressed (-2σ)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-1.0, to=1.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05, label='Normal Range')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=seasonal_zscore)

# --- Summary Table: Monthly Crush Spread Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Monthly Crush Spread Stats ($/bu)',
        col_headers=['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
                     'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'],
        row_size=4, col_size=12,
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name='Median', agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Mean', agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=2,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Min', agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=2,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Max', agg=AggregationType.Max, dp=2,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Crush Spread Seasonality',
    order=3
)(monthly_crush, monthly_month)
